user.title: OpenScooter
user.description: This adds your scooter to Home Assistant. Afterwards open **OpenScooter** in the sidebar and scan the QR code with the OpenScooter app.

init.title: Smart charging
init.description: Pick the smart plug your charger is connected to. It is switched on when the scooter arrives home with a low battery and switched off when charging is done. Leave the plug empty to turn smart charging off.
